# FDG7058

> DO make exceptions runtime serializable. An exception must be serializable to work correctly across application domain and remoting boundaries.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.4 Designing Custom Exceptions.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

CA2237 is not mapped: in a probe with SDK 10.0.402 (net10.0 and net472) it did not report exception types without SerializableAttribute. Analyzer candidate rejected: the reason of the text, application domain and remoting boundaries, does not exist on .NET Core, and .NET 8 made the serialization constructor of exceptions obsolete (SYSLIB0051), so a check would ask for code that current .NET warns against.
